title: Dual-Side Uncertainty Estimation: Calibrating Data and Model Uncertainty into a Shared Probability Space
abstract: arXiv:2611.29284v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Multimodal user intention analysis infers latent goals from heterogeneous behavioral observations but faces cross-modal input mismatch and output semantic errors. Existing uncertainty estimators focus on input reliability or output confidence and often reduce token uncertainty to simple statistics, overlooking structured dependencies. We propose DUE (Dual-Side Uncertainty Estimation), which jointly estimates input-side aleatoric and sentence-level epistemic uncertainty. From a single generation, Dirichlet perturbations of cross-layer representations produce an ordered token uncertainty sequence. A sequence-aware Normal-Inverse-Gamma estimator uses this sequence to quantify epistemic uncertainty and confidence in its estimate. Evidential multimodal alignment captures aleatoric uncertainty from noisy, incomplete, or inconsistent inputs. translated_title: 双侧不确定性估计：将数据不确定性与模型不确定性校准到共享概率空间
translated_abstract: 多模态用户意图分析旨在从异构的行为观测中推断潜在目标，但面临跨模态输入不匹配和输出语义错误的问题。现有不确定性估计器只关注输入可靠性或输出置信度，并且通常将词元不确定性简化为简单的统计量，忽视了结构化的依赖关系。我们提出DUE（双侧不确定性估计），联合估计输入侧的偶然不确定性和句子级认知不确定性。通过单次生成，对跨层表示施加Dirichlet扰动即可产生有序的词元不确定性序列。序列感知的Normal-Inverse-Gamma估计器利用该序列来量化认知不确定性及其估计的置信度。证据性多模态对齐则从含噪、不完整或不一致的输入中捕获偶然不确定性。DUE将两种异构的不确定性分数校准到共享的错误概率空间中，并对其进行顺序融合（原文摘要在此处截断）。
tldr: 提出DUE双侧不确定性估计方法，通过Dirichlet扰动生成词元不确定性序列并结合序列感知的Normal-Inverse-Gamma估计器，联合量化输入侧偶然不确定性与句子级认知不确定性，并将两者校准融合到统一的错误概率空间中。
en_tdlr: Proposes DUE, a dual-side uncertainty estimation framework that jointly quantifies input-side aleatoric uncertainty and sentence-level epistemic uncertainty via Dirichlet perturbations and a sequence-aware Normal-Inverse-Gamma estimator, calibrating and fusing both into a shared error-probability space.
